explanation: Most common carpal bone Fracture - Scaphoid (Radial Artery). Most common dislocated carpal Bone- Lunate (Median Nerve - Carpal tunnel). Fracture of hook of hamate - Ulnar nerve damage (Cuboidal tunnel). Anatomical snuff box pain - Radial Artery
